plugin.plex.err_bad_answer: The address does not lead to Plex Media Server.
plugin.plex.err_no_sections: None of the chosen libraries exists in Plex any more: load the libraries again.
plugin.plex.err_no_token: The Plex token is not set.
plugin.plex.err_no_url: The Plex address is not set.
plugin.plex.err_scan_failed: Some libraries could not be scanned.
plugin.plex.err_unreachable: Plex does not respond. Check the address and that Plex Media Server is running.
plugin.plex.gap_hint: Plex is asked at most once every {n} s; changes in between are sent together.
plugin.plex.intro: When torrents are added to or removed from Silo, Plex is asked to scan its libraries. Meant for a Plex library on the folder where the FUSE plugin mounts Silo.
plugin.plex.on_add: when a torrent is added or changed
plugin.plex.sections_hint: Choose the libraries on the Silo folder. None chosen = all libraries.
plugin.plex.title: Plex
plugin.plex.token_hint: Leave the token empty to keep the saved one. To find it: Plex Web → any movie → ⋯ → Get Info → View XML; the token is the X-Plex-Token value at the end of the address.
plugin.plex.url_invalid: Enter the Plex address, for example http://127.0.0.1:32400
